description: How often the clients look at things, and how long they wait. Three clients that behave alike have the same patience: a node list refreshed every minute on one platform and every five on another is two products, not one. The pending window is the one that is not a poll: how long a staged pairing is treated as alive when the gateway's own expiry could not be read, which is the invitation lifetime the gateway hands out by default. Each client asserts its own constants against these, so a cadence changed in one place is changed everywhere or the tests say so.
